Essay = Importance of Trees
Outlines = 1) Introduction 2) Other services 3) Different kinds of trees 4) Usefulness to animals 5) Other importance of trees 6) Urgent need for planting Trees 7) Conclusion
1) Introduction :- Trees are very important in our life. They provide us fruits to eat and firewood to burn. We make furniture from there woods. Trees refreshes our mind. They maintain nature balance. They provide us oxygen to breath and also absorb the carbon-dioxide that we exhale. They make starch for our food, which is necessary for our body.
2) Other services :- They cause rainfall. They enhance natural fertility of soil. They provide us shadow hot days are made cool by trees. Trees control floods. Trees binds soil in their roots so that prevent as top soil to be washed away during floods. Trees also enhances beauty. "Trees are the poems, that the Earth writes upon the sky".
3) Different kinds of Trees :- Different types of trees provide different services. Trees are of different types; some provide us fruits or some flowers. Rubber tree provides us rubber. Every part of coconut tree can be put to some use. Some of trees are sacred trees of Hindus like Peepal tree.
4) Usefulness to animals :- Trees are very useful for animals too. The leaves of trees are food for several animals. Trees play an important role in food chain.
5) Other Importance of Trees :- We worship trees. Some trees are sacred to Hindus. Trees are so beautiful. Trees are important not only because they provide us services but also for their beauty. Trees refreshes our mind and our eyes. Our day become so nice and good in presence of trees. "Save trees now, They will save you in future".
6) Urgent need of Planting Trees :- Once upon a time, Trees are in large percentage in our country, but as population grew, Trees used to be cut and then houses be made in these places. But there is a need for planting Trees. Some communities even protecting trees from their own. Government also making efforts for planting more and more trees. We should plant trees. We should plant one tree and take its full care.
7) Conclusion :- Trees are so important, we ought to save trees. Afforestation should be done. Trees are also important for our regular education, because the papers also get from trees; "Grow more and more trees" "Be Happy!" "Live a long life"

Picture Writing — Good Habits: This picture belongs to Good Habits for a student. Every disciplined student follow some daily routine, and these are his/her good qualities. This picture is telling us about "Good Habits", to get up early in morning, then to do some exercise, to have a healthy breakfast of milk and nuts. Good Habits are so necessary. A person with Good Habits use to be loving person of all family members and society members. This picture also visualise more Good Habits like, to respect teachers and elders, to go to bed early and maintain cleanliness around ourselves. These all Good Habits keep us Healthy, make our future and make us a Good person.
